Perfect! All tests pass now. 

**Root cause:** The `bulk_discount` function in `shopcart/pricing.py` was using `>` instead of `>=` for the threshold check. This meant the 10% bulk discount was only applied when quantity exceeded the threshold (>10), not when it met or exceeded it (>=10).

**The fix:** Changed line 14 from `if qty > BULK_THRESHOLD:` to `if qty >= BULK_THRESHOLD:` to properly implement the documented behavior of "10% off the line when buying BULK_THRESHOLD units or more."
